text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install an accessible loading zone on the east side of Scarborough Road, north of Woodale Avenue. The loading zone will operate between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, to provide curb side access for Wheel-Trans. This designation will not eliminate any overnight permit parking spaces.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible loading zone to operate from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the east side of Scarborough Road, between a point 9.0 metres north of Woodale Avenue and a point 10.5 metres further north.
